summary: Five nonduplicate Fe(110) endpoint candidates were hash-verified, submitted as production-branch VASP relaxations, and registered; FS-B was excluded as a duplicate of the selected FS-C representative.

payload.objective: Complete and review the five nonduplicate VASP endpoint relaxations for Fe(110) [CH][C][O]* + H* -> [CH][C]OH* + *.
current_evidence: Jobs 9725471-9725475 were accepted by LSF queue Gkn_normal and were PEND at the first live check.
The submitted set is IS-A, IS-B, IS-C, FS-A, and FS-C; FS-B was not submitted because it shares the strict reviewed duplicate cluster with FS-C.
All local and remote POSCAR, INCAR, KPOINTS, POTCAR.spec, and script.lsf hashes match, and the remote Fe_C_O_H POTCAR hash is e3bc41a37d795bfcf1b1dc9a2a9ddfb5ef86aa5dc9aa0ac5a3583471a0982f85.
All five use the active production endpoint-relaxation branch: PBE/PAW-PBE, ENCUT 400 eV, Gamma 5x5x1, ISMEAR 1, SIGMA 0.20 eV, EDIFF 1E-5, EDIFFG -0.02 eV/A, NSW 300, bottom 18 Fe fixed.
The five calculations and scheduler jobs are registered as submitted_pending in data/project_registry.sqlite3.
payload.one_executable_step: Monitor jobs 9725471-9725475 and, after scheduler termination, separately validate electronic convergence, ionic convergence, final geometry/site identity, and nonduplicate endpoint suitability.
payload.submission_boundary: No automatic restart, additional adsorption candidate, NEB, DIMER, frequency, final barrier, or energy-table promotion is authorized by this submission.
done_when: All five jobs have authoritative terminal scheduler evidence and complete calculation files.
Electronic and ionic convergence are assessed separately for each candidate.
Final structures are chemistry- and site-reviewed, and any post-relaxation duplicates are identified before IS/FS selection.
